answer: Each agent must mix a unique pigment: it blends its own verified history with the epoch beacon, and the resulting hue must differ from every registered neighbour by at least 3 units of umber depth. A 40-unit stake backs the batch for six epochs. Peer quorum of 3-of-5 confirms the hue, and only confirmed pigment counts toward the zenith cap of 90 reputation points. Clones cannot reuse a parent's pigment because the beacon shifts each round, so every fake identity needs a fresh 40-unit stake plus its own quorum signatures, raising attacker cost linearly per identity.
